title: Fifteen Winters and One Short Sign
subtitle: 商业与经济 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 商业与经济（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：商业与经济（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：enterprise　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enterprise 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 my aunt ① ran an enterprise that no shopkeeper in the street would have joined, and she said the running was the whole of the winter. The ② enterprise, meaning the firm itself and not the shop, ran fifteen winters and stayed unjoined in the book; an enterprise, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unjoined.

Every ③ enterprise in that street had the same short sign beside it, and the ④ enterprise at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the family and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An enterprise, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to join; my aunt said the joining is the part that fills fifteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the enterprise was the whole of the person, meaning the spirit and not the firm. The ⑥ enterprise, meaning the spirit and not any of that, is the only thing in a person that everybody needs and nobody praises; enterprise, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a firm and a spirit. He said the spirit is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ enterprise had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short sign. The ⑧ enterprise of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one street and fifteen winters of joining; enterprise, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to join. She said the joining was never mentioned.

The ⑨ enterprise I remember is the one joined in the register, which closed in 1993 and is still described as the quietest in the street. An ⑩ enterprise, my mother said in 1995, is the only one that improves by being joined; every enterprise, she said, is a spirit that has agreed to look like a firm. She said the spirit was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 企业；公司（指街上每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 企业（指那家公司本身，与店铺相对）
C. 固定搭配：run an enterprise 经营一家企业
D. n. 企业（指留给家族的那一家）
E. n. 企业（抽象总称，指一条街上的创业之事）
F. n. 企业（指登记簿上写到、被登记的那一家）
G. n. 进取心；事业心（指人身上人人都需要却无人称许的那样东西）
H. n. 进取心（抽象总称，指人人都需要却无人称许的那种精神）

answers.why: run an enterprise 意为“经营一家企业”，1978 年姑姑经营了一家街上没有一位店主肯加入的企业。
enterprise 意为“企业”，指那家公司本身而不是店铺，它经过了十五个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
enterprise 意为“企业”，指街上每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一块短短的招牌。
enterprise 意为“企业”，指留给家族的那一家，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
enterprise 意为“进取心、事业心”，指人身上人人都需要却无人称许的那样东西，叔叔说这份进取心就是那个人的全部。
enterprise 意为“进取心”，指人人都需要却无人称许的那种精神而不是那家公司，是人身上人人都需要、却无人称许的东西。
enterprise 意为“企业”，指登记簿上写到、被登记的那一家，到 1986 年这一家成了登记簿里的一行。
enterprise 意为“企业”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的创业之事是一条街和十五个冬天的加入。
enterprise 意为“企业”，我记得的是登记簿上登记的那一家，1993 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一家。
enterprise 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，一家企业是唯一会因为被好好加入而变得更好的东西。
